subject: general
question: On whose advice does the Governor appoint the ministers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chief Minister**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Governor appoints the ministers on the advice of the **Chief Minister**.
 
• This is in accordance with the provisions laid down in the Constitution of India.
 
• The Chief Minister is the head of the state government and advises the Governor in the formation of the Council of Ministers.
